name: trivia-game
description: Local Wi-Fi trivia game — build scripts for the single-server / single-exe distribution.

scripts.build:web: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd backend && npm install && cd .. && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.build:exe: npm run build:web && npm run bundle && npm run build:server && node scripts/make-sea.mjs
